integrity: A self-contained proof, complete finite-state arithmetic, and standard-library finite verifier are provided. Finite tests do not prove infinite claims; mathematical independence and external certification are not asserted.
scientific_limitations: The valuation distribution applies only to the order-three Fuss-Catalan numbers, the prime two, and initial intervals of length a power of two. The digit-sum/carry identity is classical; the explicit distribution, moment, sharp extremal and Gaussian constants are the proposed contribution. Equivalent specialization in unlocated digital-carry literature remains a novelty risk.
title: Exact dyadic two-adic valuation spectra of ternary Fuss-Catalan numbers
